raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "work at"
      role subject ?x
      role object "Atelier Dobre"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "refer to"
      role subject ?x
      role object "Minh"
      polarity negated
    end
  end
